### How this work is cited

Passages inside On Liberty are identified by chapter (i–v). Five chapters, of which the second — 'Of the Liberty of Thought and Discussion' — supplies most of the passages in general circulation. The corpus has one entry without a chapter, which is the less complete record.

### The work in John Stuart Mill’s thought

John Stuart Mill (1806–1873) refined utilitarianism and authored On Liberty, a classic defense of individuality against social and political tyranny. [More on John Stuart Mill](https://www.philosophydef.com/thinkers/john-stuart-mill) .
